question: List the name and location of events that underspend its budget.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "event_budgets" AS SELECT
  t1.event_id AS event_id,
  t1.event_name,
  t1.building,
  t1.room,
  t1.status AS event_status,
  CAST(t2.amount AS DOUBLE) AS budget_amount,
  t2.spent,
  t2.remaining
FROM table_1 t1
JOIN table_2 t2
  ON t2.link_to_event = t1.event_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "event_budgets" AS WITH cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    t1.event_id,
    t1.event_name,
    t1.building,
    t1.room,
    t1.status AS event_status,
    TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(t2.amount, '"', ''), ',', '')) AS amount_clean,
    t2.spent,
    t2.remaining
  FROM table_1 t1
  JOIN table_2 t2
    ON t2.link_to_event = t1.event_id
)
SELECT
  event_id,
  event_name,
  building,
  room,
  event_status,
  CAST(NULLIF(amount_clean, '') AS DOUBLE) AS budget_amount,
  CAST(spent AS DOUBLE) AS spent,
  CAST(remaining AS DOUBLE) AS remaining
FROM cleaned

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_name,
    building,
    room,
    event_status,
    SUM(budget_amount) AS total_budget,
    SUM(spent) AS total_spent
  FROM event_budgets
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
)
SELECT
  event_name,
  building,
  room
FROM agg
WHERE event_status = 'Closed' AND (total_budget - total_spent) > 0
ORDER BY event_name;
